body:
`CalibreDB.get_typeahead` builds its filter as `func.lower(database.name).ilike("%" + query + "%")`
with the user's term interpolated directly, so a literal `%` or `_` in what the
user types is treated as a LIKE wildcard rather than as a character.

Typing "50%" in the tag field matches every tag beginning "50", and "_" matches
any single character. Parameterised through SQLAlchemy, so this is not an
injection — it is a correctness/UX wrinkle: you cannot search for a value that
contains one of those characters, and a lone "%" matches the whole library.

Pre-existing; predates the #1398 ranking work and was left alone there to keep
that change scoped to the reported defect. Fix would be to escape `%`, `_` and
the escape character itself in the term and pass `escape="\\"` to `ilike`.

Observed 2026-08-14 while fixing #1398.
title: Typeahead query interpolates the raw term into a LIKE pattern, so % and _ act as wildcards
